answer_1.quote: We present a novel benchmark dataset, named IfQA, where each of over 3,800 questions is based on a counterfactual presupposition defined via an "if" clause... We evaluate both state-of-the-art close-book and open-book models ... then use a reader to ... predict an answer.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to counterfactual open-domain QA questions

answer_2.quote: We use two commonly used metrics to evaluate the end-QA performance: exact match (EM) and F1 score.
